book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: بيتين فقيرين جنب بعض، وبكل بيت أربع ولاد.
sentences.en: Two poor houses side by side, four children in each.
The children played in the dirt together.
One day, a fine carriage stopped in front of them.

sentences.ar: نزلت منها سيدة وصارت تتطلع بالولاد.
sentences.en: A lady got out and began looking at the children.

sentences.ar: قالت لأهل البيت الأول: أعطوني ولد.
sentences.en: She said to the first family: give me a child.
We will raise him and he will be rich and visit you.
The first family drove her off in anger.

sentences.ar: أهل البيت التاني وافقوا وأخذوا مصاري.
sentences.en: The second family agreed and took money.
The neighbours stopped speaking to them for years.

sentences.ar: بعد عشرين سنة، رجع الولد برجل وسيم وغني.
sentences.en: After twenty years, the boy came back a fine, wealthy man.

sentences.ar: ابن البيت الأول تطلع من الشباك وشافه.
sentences.en: The son of the first house looked from the window and saw him.

sentences.ar: هديك الليلة، ترك البيت وما رجع.
sentences.en: That night, he left the house and did not return.
